hypothesis: H-151 net share issuance (bottom-minus-top quintile, one-month hold)

spec.universe: US common stock, price >= $3.0, cap $100,000,000-$10,000,000,000 at formation
spec.point_in_time: a filing is usable from filed date + 1 trading session
spec.book: quintiles, bottom long / top short, equal weight, one-month hold
spec.entry: next session OPEN after the month-end close
spec.exit: close of the next month end
spec.score_convention: gpa_score = -z(NIS) so that higher score = expected higher return, which is what the harness measures

factor_regression.model: ls_net = alpha + b*MKT + s*SMB + h*HML + r*RMW
factor_regression.month_assignment: factor month = month AFTER formation (the month held)
factor_regression.ir_basis: appraisal ratio = monthly alpha / sd(FF4 residuals) * sqrt(12); the model-free IR of the raw spread is reported beside it because the FF4 fit can absorb part of the signal

verdict.rule: every frozen gate must pass. Any single failure is NOT_PROVEN; the spec is not re-ranked after seeing the result.
